blurb: Input field with a glowing radial gradient that follows the mouse cursor.
description: An input component wrapped in a motion.div that renders a radial gradient glow centered at the cursor position on hover, tracking mouse movement with Framer Motion.
use_when: Creating premium forms where cursor-following effects enhance visual feedback and interactivity.
avoid_when: On touch devices or when motion should be minimal.
a11y: Standard input accessibility applies; the glow effect is purely visual and does not interfere with interaction.
